food_beverage_category.label: Food / beverage category
food_beverage_category.value: Diversified shelf-stable packaged foods: canned vegetables and beans, spices and seasonings, syrups, sauces, pickles, peppers, hot sauce, plus some frozen vegetables

brand_private_label_manufacturing.label: Brand / private-label manufacturing
brand_private_label_manufacturing.value: Owned and acquired branded consumer food portfolio, with some private-label and foodservice production

shelf_life_storage_condition.label: Shelf life / storage condition
shelf_life_storage_condition.value: Mostly shelf-stable pantry products, with a smaller frozen vegetable line

processing_technology.label: Processing technology
processing_technology.value: Canning, packing, blending and bottling; freezing for frozen vegetables

temperature_controlled_logistics.label: Temperature-controlled logistics
temperature_controlled_logistics.value: Mainly ambient distribution; frozen warehousing and distribution for the frozen products

customer_channel_sales_mix.label: Customer-channel sales mix
customer_channel_sales_mix.value: Mostly grocery retail and mass merchants, with smaller foodservice, club and other channels

input_food_safety_exposure.label: Input / food-safety exposure
input_food_safety_exposure.value: Agricultural commodity, packaging and freight cost exposure; food safety is stated as top priority

notes: Website evidence is thin; most facets rely on general knowledge of B&G Foods.
